title: HELIX Terminology: Course Level
description: Academic level classification for catalog courses.

codes.definition: Below college-level. Does not count toward degree credit.
300-400 level. Advanced undergraduate courses requiring prerequisites.
700+ level. Doctoral seminars, research, dissertation hours.
Professional program courses (law, medicine, etc.) with their own numbering conventions.
Continuing education, professional development, or community courses not carrying academic credit.

notes: Course number ranges (100/200/300/etc.) are a common convention but not universal. Institution-specific number-to-level mappings should be documented in Bridge implementations.
